description: The ingredient proportions for Whiskey Sour are wrong. Correct them based on the IBA standards.

recipe.name: Whiskey Sour
recipe.garnish: Half an orange slice and cherry
recipe.preparation: Dash egg white (Optional: if used shake little harder to foam up the egg white). Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake. Strain into cocktail glass. If served ‘On the rocks’, strain ingredients into old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
